description: This PHP source file defines the class Zend_Http_UserAgent_Offline, which extends Zend_Http_UserAgent_Desktop. It provides functionality to identify offline user agents based on signatures and retrieve the type of user agent.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Offline
classes.description: Represents an offline user agent with methods to match user agent signatures and get its type.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Checks if the user agent string matches known offline signatures.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the user agent, which is 'offline'.
